title: Path jail does not protect the guard modules
root_cause: check_path jails to PROJECT_ROOT but does not exclude the guard/persistence files inside it

trace.description: model-controlled write with path jail check

evidence.description: allowed_roots = [PROJECT_ROOT]; no write-deny set for guard files

fix: deny writes to src/, cron_jobs.json, sessions/, config; restrict tool writes to sandbox/ and runs/

title: Write-then-execute RCE inside the jail
root_cause: check_shell blocks 'python -c' but not 'python <file>'; write_file can place the file in-repo

trace.description: attacker-controlled file content lands in repo

evidence.description: blocklist has python -c/python3 -c but no plain interpreter-file invocation; also missing node -e, php -r, ruby -e, awk system(), sed e, powershell -EncodedCommand, certutil, bitsadmin

fix: default-deny allowlist of first words, or OS sandbox; block interpreter invocation by name

title: Secret exfiltration chain survives all guards
root_cause: shell blocklist matches cat .env but not cp+glob; read_file has no redaction; http_post_json allows any public URL

trace.description: no key redaction on output (only shell redacts, tools.py:78)
POST body to any public URL completes exfil

evidence.description: CREDS_PATH default ~/.flippy/credentials.env is the canonical secret file

fix: redact in all read tools; deny cp/glob of credential-like names; make runs/ and sessions/ non-model-readable

title: Non-loopback bind without auth token is not enforced
root_cause: main() honors HOST=0.0.0.0 with no check for FLIPPY_AUTH_TOKEN

trace.description: BIND_HOST from env; no token enforcement

fix: refuse or hard-warn on non-loopback bind without token; add 401 tests

title: dispatch(remember, null) crashes the agent run
root_cause: remember special-case outside dispatch try/except; args not validated

trace.description: args.get on None raises AttributeError, uncaught

fix: validate isinstance(args, dict) in parser; wrap entire dispatch body
